scope.score: conditional location suitability for explicit business concept, excluding detailed financial assumptions

formula.component_score: 100 * approved utility in [0,1]; null until valid rule exists
formula.dimension_score: sum(fixed_component_weight_percent * admitted_component_score) / 100, only when every required component passes
formula.overall_score: sum(fixed_dimension_weight_percent * unrounded_dimension_score) / 100, only when all four dimensions and readiness publication gates pass
formula.normalisation: no fitted rescaling, no softmax, no missing redistribution
formula.rounding: round_half_up only displayed final score; preserve exact unrounded intermediates

correlation_policy.method: single component ownership and fixed budgets; reject duplicate metric/observation lineage
correlation_policy.nested_catchments: choose one scoring scope; other travel bands diagnostic
correlation_policy.sources: corroboration does not add another contribution
correlation_policy.cross_component_parent_overlap: allowed for distinct justified constructs with recorded overlap; same latent measure never multiple favourable points

factor_meaning.0.5: material limitation incompatible with numeric suitability publication

quality.reliability: min(axes, required parent reliabilities); diagnostic index, not probability
quality.compound_parents: minimum, never count number of sources as reliability boost
quality.global_quality_threshold_reason: require adequacy for every essential claim; global average cannot rescue one weak essential input
quality.internal_quality_index: 100 * weighted_mean(admitted reliability * presence), fixed component and dimension weights
quality.quality_badges: insufficient on absent/invalid essential; limited on material limitation; moderate on qualified adequate support; good only all axes 1 with no material gap

coverage.score_input_presence: sum(fixed weights of admitted inputs)/sum(all applicable fixed weights)
coverage.allocation_threshold_basis: Phase 8 conservative engineering hypothesis, calibration required; larger material uncertainty withholds quantitative score
coverage.not_applicable: freeze before retrieval using explicit concept and versioned rule; new scope manifest, never inferred from source failure

publication.full_dimension: all required component, rule, comparator, licence, scope, parent quality and contradiction gates pass
publication.full_overall: four full dimensions; no unresolved critical feasibility question or confirmed blocker; readiness separately visible
publication.missing_bounds: internal only: missing fixed-budget component utility spans [0,100]; logical bound, never confidence interval
publication.metric_only: descriptive values or independently admitted same-scope percentile; no suitability label
publication.qualitative: evidence-linked scoped direction if supported; retain important unknown
publication.no_assessment: no admissible evidence or rule for that claim
publication.required_rule_calibration: blocked until independently reviewed rule and held-out assessment exist
publication.percentile_of_composite: withhold unless peers have same complete method/profile/scope/gates; score/100 is not percentile

readiness.confirmed_blocker: Do not proceed with present concept; overall numeric withheld, completed dimensions retained with scope
readiness.unresolved_critical: Resolve before commitment; overall numeric withheld without adverse utility imputation
readiness.confirmed_material_risk: Rework or verify mitigation before commitment; any numeric dimension unchanged by readiness layer
readiness.material_risk_numerical_gate: no automatic ceiling; significant issues remain adjacent to result
readiness.clear: only after actually completed bounded investigation; no findings in partial register insufficient
readiness.severity_authority: versioned rule plus current matched documents; AI cannot assign severity

demand/competition non-additivity uncalibrated and may duplicate pressure rule
income/differentiation bonus uncalibrated; income not spending
headroom/capacity outside location score, duplicated scenario risk

comparison.labels: relative metric rank only; no Top 30 percent from score 70

adequate real source coverage and precision
